### Part 1
```{r}
# install.packages("ggplot2")
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
# Metropolis-Hastings Algorithm (Random Walk Metropolis)
metropolis_hastings <- function(N, s) {
  x <- numeric(N)
  accept <- 0
  for (i in 2:N) {
    x_star <- rnorm(1, mean = x[i - 1], sd = s)
    ratio <- exp(-abs(x_star)) / exp(-abs(x[i - 1]))
    u <- runif(1)
    if (log(u) < log(ratio)) {
      x[i] <- x_star
      accept <- accept + 1
    } else {
      x[i] <- x[i - 1]
    }
  }
  list(samples = x, acceptance_rate = accept / (N-1))
}
```

```{r}
# Define the Function to Calculate R̂ 
calculate_Rb <- function(chains) {
  J <- length(chains)
  N <- length(chains[[1]])

  Mj <- sapply(chains, mean)
  Vj <- sapply(chains, var)

  W <- mean(Vj)
  M <- mean(Mj)

  B <- N / (J - 1) * sum((Mj - M) ^ 2)

  Rb <- sqrt((B + W) / W)

  return(Rb)
}
```

#### Part 1(a)
```{r}
# Run the Metropolis Hastings Algorithm with N = 10000 and s = 1
N <- 10000
s <- 1
result <- metropolis_hastings(N, s)
samples <- result$samples
acceptance_rate <- result$acceptance_rate
```

```{r}
# Plot Histogram, Kernel Density Plot, and True Density
p <- ggplot(data.frame(x = samples), aes(x = x)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = ..density..), bins = 30, fill = "lightgray", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_density(color = "black") +
  stat_function(fun = function(x) 0.5 * exp(-abs(x)), color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Metropolis-Hastings Algorithm",
       x = "x",
       y = "Density") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Compute the Sample Mean, Sample Standard Deviation, and Acceptance Rate
sample_mean <- mean(samples)
sample_sd <- sd(samples)

print(sample_mean)
print(sample_sd)
print(acceptance_rate)
```

#### Part 1(b)
```{r}
# Run R̂ Over a Range of s values in the interval between 0.001 and 1
J <- 4
s_values <- seq(0.001, 1, length.out = 100)
Rb_values <- numeric(length(s_values))
N <- 2000

for (i in seq_along(s_values)) {
  s <- s_values[i]
  chains <- replicate(J, metropolis_hastings(N, s)$samples, simplify = FALSE)
  Rb_values[i] <- calculate_Rb(chains)
}
```

```{r}
# Plot R̂ Values for Metropolis-Hastings Algorithm
plot_data <- data.frame(s_values, Rb_values)

p2 <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = s_values, y = Rb_values)) +
  geom_line(color = "blue") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1.05, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(title = "Convergence Diagnostic (R̂) for Metropolis-Hastings Algorithm",
       subtitle = "R̂ near 1 indicates convergence; threshold = 1.05",
       x = "s",
       y = expression(hat(R))) +
theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Display plots
print (p)
print (p2)
```
